fields.description: Ollama runs a local vision model (Qwen2.5-VL): best for handwriting and register tables. OpenRouter sends the image to a hosted vision model via API (needs an API key). Tesseract and PaddleOCR are lighter classic OCR engines (weaker on handwriting).
fields.label: OCR Engine

fields.description: Longest edge (px) the image is downscaled to before OCR. Lower = faster, higher = more detail (better for small/handwritten text). For Ollama, raising this also raises token usage — keep Context Window (num_ctx) above it.
fields.label: Max Image Dimension

fields.description: Base URL of the Ollama server. Use the Docker service name in production (http://ollama:11434).
fields.label: Ollama URL

fields.description: Vision model tag. Pull it once with: ollama pull qwen2.5vl:3b. Swap to qwen2.5vl:7b for better accuracy (slower, more RAM).
fields.label: Ollama Model

fields.description: Seconds to wait for the model before giving up.
fields.label: Request Timeout (s)

fields.description: Context window (tokens) sent to Ollama. A vision model turns the image into many tokens; the Ollama default of 4096 overflows on higher-resolution photos and returns HTTP 400. Raise this if you raise Max Image Dimension.
fields.label: Context Window (num_ctx)

fields.description: Base URL of the PaddleOCR (PaddleX) serving sidecar. paddlepaddle has no Python 3.14 wheels, so PaddleOCR runs as a separate container reached over HTTP (see docs/compose.paddleocr.yaml). In a devcontainer use http://host.docker.internal:8080.
fields.label: PaddleOCR Service URL

fields.description: Language code passed to PaddleOCR (e.g. en, ml, fr).
fields.label: Language

fields.description: Seconds to wait for the PaddleOCR service before giving up.
fields.label: Request Timeout (s)

fields.description: Tesseract language code(s), e.g. eng, mal, or eng+mal. The matching language data pack must be installed.
fields.label: Language

fields.description: Your OpenRouter API key (https://openrouter.ai/keys). Stored encrypted.
fields.label: OpenRouter API Key

fields.description: OpenRouter model id (must support vision/images), e.g. qwen/qwen2.5-vl-72b-instruct, google/gemini-2.0-flash-001, openai/gpt-4o-mini.
fields.label: OpenRouter Model

fields.description: Seconds to wait for OpenRouter before giving up.
fields.label: Request Timeout (s)
